SELECT
									a.prd_code,
									a.vou_dt,
									a.acc_year,
									a.acc_mth,
									a.vou_typ,
									a.vou_typ_name,
									a.vou_clafy,
									a.vou_no,
									a.vou_etnb,
									a.vou_abs,
									a.crse_code,
									a.crse_dir,
									a.crse_dim,
									a.crse_dim_code,
									a.crse_type,
									a.crse_typ,
									a.inv_typ,
									a.cir_id,
									a.secu_code,
									a.secu_name,
									a.secu_typ,
									a.secu_typi,
									a.secu_typii,
									a.mkt_typ,
									a.ast_stat,
									a.curr_code,
									a.pos_dir,
									a.trd_typ,
									a.lcrrc_deb_val,
									a.lcrrc_cs_val,
									a.frc_val,
									a.sett_crrc,
									a.vol,
									a.excr,
									a.is_true,
									a.is_add_manu,
									a.busi_date,
									a.task_rs_id,
									a.dm_created_time,
									a.dm_src_info,
									a.olcy_deb_val,
									a.olcy_cs_val,
									a.p_dt,
									a.sys_rs_id
							FROM ${srcdbname}.fin_prd_vou_min a 
							where p_dt between ${beg_date} and ${end_date} 
                and a.crse_code like '2%'
